surface_form_payload.question_text: Assign the frequency, severity, and qualitative risk categories independently.

parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Implied design intent: sustain design flow through separator V-001 and its outlet lines [CASE-01]. Deviation: Less/None flow [CASE-02, CASE-03]. Frequency: the causes [CASE-04], spurious SDV-30010 closure and partial well shutdown from electrical failure, are recurrent operational upsets rather than rare failures. The listed safeguards do not prevent either cause, so the deviation frequency is roughly the initiating-cause frequency. Judged D (Likely); C or E are plausible without plant reliability data. Severity: the consequences [CASE-05] are generator stop, SD 2 plant shutdown, inability to discharge liquid from V-001 and operational problems. These are operability and production losses; no loss of containment, fire, injury or environmental release is documented. Severity II (Moderate) is assigned: above I because a full plant shutdown and loss of generation are significant, below III because no safety or environmental escalation is documented. Safeguards [CASE-06]: FAL-103 is a detection and operator-alert measure only. Flow control can moderate partial flow reductions but cannot restore flow after SDV closure or well trips. Neither is credited with reducing the frequency or severity class. Matrix: II x D -> M. The class is robust: it stays M for severity I to III at D and for severity II at C to E; the exceptions are I-C (L) and III-E (H). The subjective probability of 25% is a labeled judgment aid only: the approximate chance of at least one such event with shutdown-type consequences in a given operating year. It is not a matrix input. Recommendations for team consideration: investigate SDV-30010 spurious-trip mechanisms and trip-logic reliability, such as position feedback, voting and solenoid maintenance. Verify that FAL-103 is independent of the flow-control measurement and define the required operator response. Clarify how the generators depend on V-001 outlet flow and evaluate backup supply. Review electrical-system reliability for well power. Define a V-001 liquid-handling and restart procedure after SD 2.
safeguards_considered: FAL-103 low-flow alarm: detection and operator alert only. Credited for awareness, not prevention; setpoint, independence from the flow-control loop and response time are not stated.

Flow control: basic process control. It may moderate flow reductions from a partial well shutdown but cannot restore flow after a spurious SDV-30010 closure; it is not an independent protection layer.
SD 2 plant shutdown is listed as a consequence in the packet and is not credited as a safeguard.
No credit is taken for measures absent from the packet, such as backup power or fuel for the generators, SDV position indication or electrical-system redundancy.

supporting_evidence.relevance: Defines the node scope (separator V-001 and associated lines), from which the implied design intent of sustained throughput is taken.
The Flow parameter with the Less/None guideword defines the deviation class assessed.
The deviation covers both the vessel and its outlet lines, linking reduced flow to downstream users and to liquid discharge from V-001.
The causes (spurious SDV-30010 closure, electrical-failure partial well shutdown) are recurrent operational upsets, supporting frequency D.
The consequences are operability and production losses with no documented release, fire, injury or environmental harm, supporting severity II.
The safeguards are a low-flow alarm and basic flow control only. Neither prevents the causes or independently mitigates the shutdown consequences, so no category reduction is credited.

uncertainty_notes: No plant-specific data on SDV-30010 spurious-trip rate or electrical-system reliability are provided. Frequency D is an expert judgment, and C or E could also be argued.
The frequency and severity categories are supplied only as labels, without numeric ranges or consequence descriptors, so category boundaries are interpretive.

The packet does not describe how less flow leads to generator stop or to the inability to discharge liquid from V-001. The severity assumes no safety-critical loads are lost when the generators stop; the packet neither confirms nor excludes this.

The location and function of SDV-30010 (inlet or outlet isolation) are not stated. If its spurious closure also causes pressure or level deviations, those need assessment under other guidewords and could raise severity.
The meaning and extent of the SD 2 shutdown level are not defined. If the facility weights production loss heavily, severity III could be argued; risk would remain M at frequency D.
FAL-103 setpoint, alarm priority, operator response time and independence from the flow-control measurement are unspecified, which limits the credit that can be taken.

The subjective probability of 25% is an explicitly labeled judgment aid for the approximate chance of such an event in a given operating year. It is not data-derived, not a quantitative risk estimate, and not an input to the qualitative matrix.
